title: user.signed_up (consumer view)
description: stapel-auth owns this fact. The fields stapel-referrals reads; anything else the owner sends is accepted. signup_context (stapel-auth >= 0.51.0) is the client's opaque object; referrals reads referral_code and referral_captured_at from it.

signup_context.description: Opaque to auth. Referrals reads referral_code (a code text) and referral_captured_at (ISO 8601, client clock); a value of another type is ignored, never a reason to drop the fact.
